notes.title: Release of the first part of the game «Sinful Soul» is almost here!
notes.notes:
Tomorrow is a day that we've been waiting for with bated breath:[i] [b]the release of the first part of our game «Sinful Soul» on Steam[/b][/i]. It's been a long and challenging journey, but we made it. We hope it will bring joy and excitement to everyone who plays it as it brought us during the development process. We can't wait for you to play our game, to experience the emotions that we put into every pixel and every line of dialogue 😊

You can also join our Discord server where we will post all the latest news about the game: https://discord.gg/SAR6Cswj
